summary: Authentication caveat stated honestly: only read-only file tools were available in this session (no shell/git), so I authenticated the content of the supplied clean detached checkout rather than recomputing commit 1db11664 / tree e1eb9536 or its signature; the checkout's plan text is the corrected D.110c-0b0b section at docs/production-hardening/production-hardening-tdd-plan-v2.md:93081-93309, and I reconstructed the correction delta by diffing that text against the immutable pre-correction version preserved in .logs/d110c-0b0b-design-review-22917252/grok/review.diff:6100-6257. The one batch closes the union (Opus P1 + P2x3, Grok P2) without widening scope. (1) The blocking P1 is closed: the opener no longer takes an epoch-0 genesisTrust capability (the string 'genesisTrust' now survives only in the acceptance narrative at 93293-93298). Its input is the already-shaped caller-held invite, and packages/node/src/internal/creator-successor-live.ts:83-97 really declares pinnedGenesisAnchorDigest, exactCanonicalAnchorPreimageBytes, detachedSignature, and snapshotDeclaration (object scope read at packages/node/src/creator-adoption.ts:911 and passed as expectedObjectId at :959). Those fields already carry genesis meaning today: packages/node/src/v3-live.ts:2162-2175 hashes exactCanonicalAnchorPreimageBytes under 'ts-drp/epoch-anchor/v3' and requires equality with pinnedGenesisAnchorDigest, and the epoch-0 reopen at creator-adoption.ts:993-997 byte-matches them against the genesis trust record opened by openCurrentAnchorTrust, so freezing genesis semantics is compatible with the first transition and adds no product-input field (grep confirms no packages/** reference to openCreatorCheckpointTrust, inspectBoundedCreatorTrustAdvance, or a new subpath; protocol-v3/package.json and control-plane/package.json export rosters are unchanged, with ./creator-close and ./creator-trust-advance as precedent). (2) The pin-plus-carrier binding is sound and needs no epoch-0 trust: packages/protocol-v3/src/index.ts:1290-1324 is the existing proof that a genesis preimage hashed to the pin fixes objectId, epoch 0, ZERO previousAnchor/cutDigest, profileDigest and signerSetDigest, and that the creator key comes only from carriers whose SHA-256 domain hashes equal those anchor fields; index.ts:723-745 confirms the anchor record commits both digests. An attacker cannot substitute a self-signed genesis because the digest must equal the caller-held pin, and record substitution is blocked by the newly added objectId/genesisAnchorDigest equalities (93124-93126), which mirror index.ts:1403-1405 and creator-close.ts:596-601 (Opus P2#2 closed). Requiring the predecessor remains necessary and bounded because seal.ts:271-311 binds the authority to the predecessor's objectId/epoch/anchor and seal.ts:450-460 rejects any QC whose objectId/epoch differ, while creator-close.ts:627-637 fixes the cut through successorAnchor byte equality; the predecessor's identity is itself pinned by the authenticated current anchor's previousAnchor, so no recursive walk or new trust root appears. (3) The active-plus-two mapping is now correct: creator-adoption.ts:919-946 shows two head advances per transition (active = successor-live, proposedGeneration = adoption closure holding successor trust + cut + QC, currentGeneration = older live closure holding the predecessor trust), and closed-epoch-cleanup.ts:270-297/336-341 retains exactly active + first + second and literally names 'second' the floor; storage/src/maintenance.ts:414-433,495-512 keeps blobs referenced by any retained closure. So the corrected sentence (93175-93178, 91783-91791) is right where the pre-correction text (review.diff:6178-6179) was off by one, and the same law explains why the epoch-0 generation/blob is genuinely reclaimable at N>=2 (Opus P2#1 closed; the stop-and-reslice trigger on any extra head advance is stated). (4) Retirement derivation is executable and cannot delete arbitrary refs: control-plane/src/anchor-trust.ts:390-406 already exposes digest-verified scannable candidate bytes and enforces exactly one drp-anchor-trust-state per closure, so decoding one drp-hard-epoch-cut plus one commit-phase drp-seal-qc and requiring digest/length equality is executable; the delta stays the creator-trust-advance.ts:88-99 idiom minus the two retiring refs, so every other ref must be preserved byte-for-byte and wrong-kind/epoch/currentness or set-algebra mismatch fails closed (Opus P2#3 closed). (5) The umbrella is reconciled to the one-trust law: 91752 and 91769 now say the invite carrier 'is not a second trust-state member' and the active generation 'retains no genesis trust-state member'; 'pin-verifiable' no longer occurs in the plan, closing Grok's P2 against anchor-trust.ts:404-406. The carrier is counted as one O(1) bootstrap item by D.110c-c/d (91771-91773) with Phase 7 owning new-client delivery (93219-93220). The batch adds no record/wire field, dependency, crypto/setup, authority, threshold, provider operation, migration format, product-input field, or production source, so no reslice is required; the design remains O(1), fail closed, causal, and compatible, and 0b1 RED/GREEN plus the c/d census can enforce the stated obligations.

findings.title: Two-head-advances-per-transition invariant is load-bearing but only asserted in prose
findings.evidence: Plan 93174-93178 and 91783-91791 make the active/adoption/floor mapping the sole reason the predecessor trust survives, and closed-epoch-cleanup.ts:270-297 retains exactly active plus two Superseded generations with zero margin, yet the D.110c-0b1 bullets at 93190-93217 census only 'active-control' growth and retained stores; no gate asserts the per-transition head-advance count or that the floor generation still holds the epoch-(N-1) trust record at the moment of reclamation.
findings.required_action: Owner: D.110c-0b1 GREEN retention census, carried into D.110c-c/d. Add one mechanical assertion over the genuine 0->1->2 path that each transition advances the head exactly twice (revision deltas as in creator-adoption.ts:929-930) and that the retained floor closure still contains the epoch-(N-1) drp-anchor-trust-state before reclamation runs. No plan prose rewrite is requested.
